item.title: Paradise - Season 2 - First Look Photos + Press Release
item.description: Promotional Photos Press Release Xavier searches for Teri out in the world and learns how people survived the three years since The Day. Back in Paradise, the social fabric frays as the bunker deals with the aftermath of Season 1, and new secrets are uncovered about the city’s origins. Source: Hulu

item.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles - Season 1 - First Look Photos + Press Release
item.description: Promotional Photos Press Release “Margo’s Got Money Troubles” is a bold, heartwarming and comedic family drama following recent college dropout and aspiring writer, Margo (Elle Fanning), the daughter of an ex-Hooter’s waitress (Michelle Pfeiffer) and ex-pro wrestler (Nick Offerman), as she’s forced to make her way with a new baby, a mounting pile of bills and a dwindling amount of ways to pay them. Source: AppleTV

item.title: The Last Thing He Told Me - Season 2 - First Look Photos + Press Release
item.description: Promotional Photos Press Release In season two of “The Last Thing He Told Me,” when Owen (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) shows up after five years on the run, Hannah (Jennifer Garner) and her stepdaughter Bailey (Angourie Rice) find themselves in a race to figure out how to reunite their family before the past catches up to them. Source: AppleTV
